title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
script:
OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic just backed a new standard to let publishers block AI scraping.
Microsoft and Anthropic joined the effort after initial reports from Search Engine Roundtable.
Publishers use a shared policy token signal to apply training preferences across multiple platforms at once.
Previously, websites had to configure opt-out settings individually for every single AI lab.
Would you block OpenAI and Google from reading your site?
